question: Should this PR remain blocked until it is rebased and backed by redacted live Signal/gateway proof, or may maintainers accept mocked handler evidence while choosing it as the canonical Signal retry fix?
rationale: This external PR changes a live message-delivery path, overlaps another open candidate, and current maintainer guidance for the same issue family asks for live proof and focused side-effect coverage.

options.title: Require Rebase And Live Proof
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until it rebases cleanly, preserves current Signal batching metadata, adds focused retry/side-effect coverage, and posts redacted Signal/gateway proof.

options.title: Accept Synthetic Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the mocked regression evidence, but would own the unproven live Signal delivery and duplication risk.

options.title: Consolidate Elsewhere
options.body: If another Signal retry branch becomes cleaner and proof-positive first, close this PR only after that canonical replacement is safe or merged.

recommendation.title: Require Rebase And Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until it rebases cleanly, preserves current Signal batching metadata, adds focused retry/side-effect coverage, and posts redacted Signal/gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle provided the clearest sibling guidance for the same Signal retry issue family and is tied to the current Signal handler history.
